title: Counter Adjudication Settings for the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs
content:
At the dispensing counter each program type of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs is applied in its own way. This table gives, per program type, its application priority, whether it pays after insurance on the same fill, how it is applied, and whether its fills come only from Kestrel Specialty Pharmacy.

| Program type | Application priority (lower is considered first) | Pays after the patient's insurance on the same fill | How the program is applied at the counter | Program fills dispensed only by Kestrel Specialty Pharmacy |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Rx Discount Card | 6 | No | Cash price table | No |
| Kestrel Rx Savings Club Individual | 5 | No | Cash price table | No |
| Kestrel Rx Savings Club Family | 5 | No | Cash price table | No |
| Manufacturer Copay Card | 1 | Yes | Secondary claim | No |
| Manufacturer Bridge Program | 3 | No | Free-drug claim | Yes |
| Charitable Foundation Copay Grant | 2 | Yes | Secondary claim | No |

## Keys to the table

- **Application priority** — the order in which programs are considered for the same fill, lower first: Manufacturer Copay Card 1, Charitable Foundation Copay Grant 2, Manufacturer Bridge Program 3, the two club memberships 5, Kestrel Rx Discount Card 6.
- **Pays after insurance** — Yes for the Manufacturer Copay Card and the Charitable Foundation Copay Grant; No for the other four.
- **Cash price table** — the program prices a cash fill. **Secondary claim** — the program is billed after the insurance claim. **Free-drug claim** — the program supplies the fill at no cost.
- **Kestrel Specialty Pharmacy only** — Yes for the Manufacturer Bridge Program alone.

## Points of comparison

| Pair compared | Lower priority number |
|---|---|
| Manufacturer Copay Card and Charitable Foundation Copay Grant | Manufacturer Copay Card (1 against 2) |
| Manufacturer Bridge Program and a club membership | Manufacturer Bridge Program (3 against 5) |
| Club membership and Kestrel Rx Discount Card | Club membership (5 against 6) |
